experiments.name: raw12_reference
experiments.purpose: Reference conditioning using all 12 raw ERA5 predictors.

experiments.name: moisture_only
experiments.purpose: Measure how much occurrence/intensity skill is retained by moisture predictors alone.

experiments.name: thermal_only
experiments.purpose: Measure skill retained by thermal predictors alone, especially at high thresholds.

experiments.name: dynamics_only
experiments.purpose: Measure skill retained by wind/dynamics predictors alone, including possible spatial-organization signal.

experiments.name: no_dynamics
experiments.purpose: Leave dynamics out while preserving moisture + thermal predictors.

experiments.name: no_thermal
experiments.purpose: Leave thermal predictors out while preserving moisture + dynamics.

experiments.name: no_moisture
experiments.purpose: Leave moisture predictors out while preserving thermal + dynamics.

experiments.name: raw12_plus_all_derived
experiments.purpose: Test whether deterministic derived representations improve optimization/conditioning relative to raw12.

experiments.name: raw12_plus_moisture_derived
experiments.purpose: Isolate representational effect of relative-humidity vertical contrast.

experiments.name: raw12_plus_thermal_derived
experiments.purpose: Isolate representational effect of temperature contrasts.

experiments.name: raw12_plus_dynamics_derived
experiments.purpose: Isolate representational effect of wind speeds and bulk wind differences.
